errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the x-axis labels are set for July of each year. The chart shows labels for every six months, including January of each year (e.g., 01/2015, 01/2016).
The description claims the purple line dips to approximately 30 around 2017. According to the chart, there is no such dip. The lowest point around that period is approximately 40 in early 2018.
